For more information: www.globalaccessdx.com

Name: Unicorn Biotechnologies
Description:
Built a full-stack integrated platform (hardware and software) for autonomous scientific discovery and manufacturing (aka autonomous science/scientists). 

We are not just scientists. 

We don't just engineer cells. 

We don't just do software. 

We build the hardware backbone on which science will run, and integrate it all into devices that aren't the size and cost of a house.

We call our system "Emmet".  Your scientific, machine learning driven, scientifically augmented co-pilot.

Faster science, quicker impact without the cost.  Also, no more cell culture weekend work leads to happier and more productive scientists/engineers to research, discover and build further impact-driven solutions.

Name: Accession Therapeutics Limited
Description:
Accession Therapeutics is developing novel immuno-oncology therapeutics  combining high specificity and potency to counter tumor diversity. It is the first company to have engineered a viral point of entry to cancer cells while bypassing healthy cells - so its gloves off in the fight against cancer."

Name: Oxsed
Description:
We believe accurate, rapid testing should be accessible to the entire world.

Oxsed was founded in April 2020 by world-leading scientists from the University of Oxford, a global leader in infectious diseases research.

Our vision and ambition is to create a world where disease doesn’t disrupt normal life. We aim to minimise the impact of disease on individuals and communities by providing accurate and rapid testing throughout the world.

Name: Assay Genie
Description:
Assay Genie is a global life reagents company with over 120,000 products including immunoassays, antibodies, proteins & activity assays for research and development scientists.
Founded in 2017, Assay Genie has offices in Dublin, Ireland & London, UK. With distributors in over 70 countries, Assay Genie works with scientists all around the World and counts Pfizer, J&J, Harvard University and many more of the World’s leading companies & universities among its customers.

Company Achievements & Core Technologies
Since its inception in 2017, Assay Genie has gone form strength-to-strength. The company began by building a unique digital ecommerce platform to provide immunoassays to cancer and immunology research scientists. Shortly after, Assay Genie launched over 7,000 immunoassays and in 2018 added a further 50,000 antibodies to their digital catalogue. During this period, Assay Genie added distribution partners in key markets such as the USA, UK, France, Germany and Benelux, allowing them to continue their rapid growth trajectory. 2019 saw the launch of a new technology called GeniePlex multiplex immunoassays which allowed immunology research scientists to get up to 24 times the amount of data from their experiments meaning vast workflow improvements. Since then, Assay Genie have added partners in Japan, Australia, MENA and Latin America as well as China which has become one of their biggest export partners. In 2020, Assay Genie were one of the 1st global companies to respond to SARS-CoV-2 with the launch of rapid antibody tests. Seeing a major demand for raw materials, they quickly brought vaccine and testing components such as antigens and antibodies to the market. As of 2022, Assay Genie provides over 120,000 products to scientists in over 70 countries.

Name: Biophilica
Description: We transform green waste into a leather-like material that is low-resource, recyclable, and compostable.

Name: Azotic Technologies
Description:
Azotic is an innovative biotech company specializing in the development and commercialization of novel biologicals for the agricultural sector. We are a global leader in biological nitrogen fixation and are expanding the commercialization of our product, Envita (known as EnceraTM in Europe), to farmers across the globe. Our patented technology can fix nitrogen across crops, providing enhanced yield, plant health, savings on nitrogen fertilizer, carbon abatement and reduced environmental impact.

With sites in the UK and North America, we are a rapidly developing company with a unique product portfolio and an exciting product pipeline extending and expanding beyond nitrogen fixation. 

Nitrogen is critical for plant growth, and most crops require synthetic Nitrogen fertilizer. The irony is that air is roughly 80% nitrogen, but most plants can't metabolize it - until now. Envita can draw Nitrogen out of the air and make it available within plants to grow. 

Our product effectively turns crops into nitrogen-fixing machines by providing systemic season-long nitrogen in the right place at the right time. The result is higher yields and quality with less need for fertilizer. The product delivers productivity AND sustainability and is actively growing to bring this revolutionary innovation worldwide. We are registered across the continental USA, Canada, and Europe, with multiple registrations pending across the globe.

Name: Cellomatics Biosciences Ltd
Description:
Cellomatics is an ISO-certified, specialised preclinical CRO with expertise in translational human cell-based models. We support drug discovery across multiple therapeutic areas by capturing disease biology in physiologically relevant systems, enabling more predictive and clinically meaningful insights.

At Cellomatics Biosciences Ltd., we understand the complexities of immunology research and the importance of generating data you can trust. Our immunology assay services are designed to accelerate discovery and development through high-quality, customizable solutions that address the unique needs of every project.

We combine:
•	Scientific expertise to ensure robust study design and execution
•	Fresh donor material sourced through our in-house volunteer recruitment and recall system
•	Advanced technologies including flow cytometry, multiplex cytokine analysis, and high-content imaging
This powerful integration enables us to deliver reliable, reproducible results that provide actionable insights into immune function and response.

Whether you are:
•	Developing novel therapeutics
•	Validating biomarkers
•	Advancing translational research
...our experienced team provides the infrastructure, flexibility, and collaboration needed to support your goals from concept through to completion.

Name: CellVoyant
Description:
CellVoyant is an AI-first biotechnology company building platforms for predictive cell analytics and AI-guided process optimisation.

In cell-based development, decisions are often made too late, and unpredictable cell behaviour makes manufacturing complex, costly, and difficult to scale. As a result, promising development programmes can fail when processes lack predictability and control.

Using standard, label-free microscopy images, our technology infers cell state and anticipates future performance—bringing quantitative insight earlier in the workflow and enabling more reliable optimisation.

Our product ecosystem includes FateViewTM, a cloud-based platform for predictive cell analytics, and FateDriveTM, an AI-guided optimisation service for improving yield, quality, and reproducibility.

Our mission is to make cell development predictive rather than reactive—reducing failed experiments and accelerating therapeutic progress.

CellVoyant is backed by venture investors with deep experience in AI and life sciences, including early backers of DeepMind, Exscientia, Recursion, and Wayve, as well as the founder and CEO of Abcam.

Name: GROW Group
Description:
Unlocking the potential of cannabis medicines for those who need it.

Our Market Access Team launches medical cannabis producers' businesses into new markets to create long-term value for them.

By combining our strengths as scientists, technologists, and commercial strategists, we create game-changing Intellectual Property that will transform the fastest growing industry in the world, medical cannabis.

Name: Amano Enzyme
Description:
We’re Amano Enzyme (or Amano for short), and our dedication to advancing enzyme technology has been unwavering for generations.

Originally founded in 1899, we’re now proud to be the global leader in specialty enzymes and the largest manufacturer in Japan. Not only that, but we focus on both classical (non-GMO) and modern biotechnology as part of our commitment to a happier, healthier world.

Discover more about our exciting innovations and how we’re making a positive impact on our website. We look forward to connecting with you!

Name: NovaBiotics Ltd
Description:
Results through innovation. We are an innovative biotechnology group with two divisions.

NovaBiotics pharma division has advanced clinical-stage product candidates for medically unmet, life-limiting inflammatory, infectious and respiratory disease.

Name: BlakBear
Description:
BlakBear tells you how fresh your food is. 

We replace shelf-life on fresh food with a sensor that actually knows. Founded by scientists from Imperial College, we sell new sensors and a freshness API, to improve quality control, add shelf-life and cut food waste from producer to consumer.

Name: Tagomics
Description: Harnessing the power of multiomics to accelerate disease understanding and diagnosis.

Name: Syntara
Description:
Syntara Limited (ASX:SNT) is a clinical stage drug development company targeting extracellular matrix dysfunction with its world-leading expertise in amine oxidase chemistry and other technologies to develop novel medicines for blood cancers and conditions linked to inflammation and fibrosis.

Syntara is managing three phase 2 clinical studies in diseases of high unmet need with a further two potential phase 1c/2 studies being evaluated for 2024. Lead candidate SNT‐5505 is for the bone marrow cancer myelofibrosis which causes a build-up of scar tissue that leads to loss of red and white blood cells and platelets. SNT-5505 has already achieved FDA Orphan Drug Designation and clearance under an Investigational New Drug Application for development in myelofibrosis.  After encouraging phase 2a trial results when used as a monotherapy in myelofibrosis, SNT-5505 is now being studied with a JAK inhibitor in a further phase 2 myelofibrosis study with interim data by Q4 2024. The protocol for another phase 1c/2 study with SNT-5505 in patients with a blood cancer called myelodysplastic syndrome is in development and expected to commence recruitment in 2H 2024.

Syntara is also advancing both oral and topical pan-LOX inhibitors in scar prevention and scar modification programs as part of an ongoing collaboration with Professor Fiona Wood and the University of Western Australia.  SNT‐4728 is being studied in collaboration with Parkinson’s UK as a best-in-class SSAO/MAOB inhibitor to treat sleep disorders and slow progression of neurodegenerative diseases like Parkinson’s by reducing neuroinflammation. 
 
Other Syntara drug candidates target fibrotic and inflammatory diseases such as kidney fibrosis, NASH, pulmonary fibrosis and cardiac fibrosis.

Syntara developed two respiratory products available in world markets (Bronchitol for cystic fibrosis and Aridol- a lung function test), for which it receives royalties.

Name: CiteAb
Description:
CiteAb provides world-class data that accelerates scientific research. Collected using innovative tech that combines machine learning and human reviewing to understand reagent use from scientific publications, this data powers all of our products.

Our search engine ranks products by citations, fundamentally changing the way researchers from the world’s top universities, pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies find reagents that work for their experiments.

We also support reagent suppliers, finance companies, scientific publishers and biopharma/biotech companies with our data services, helping these companies make more informed business decisions and accelerate their work.

Our goal is to be providing the majority of researchers and suppliers with the data they need to drive progress in the life science sector.

Name: Epsilogen Ltd
Description:
Epsilogen is a global leader in the development of immunoglobulin (IgE) antibodies to treat cancer.  IgE has several key features that make it ideal for the treatment of solid tumours including greater potency, enhanced tumour access and a long tissue half-life.

The company's lead programme targets the folate receptor alpha (FR alpha) and an anti-FR alpha IgE antibody is currently in a phase I trial to treat ovarian cancer.  This is the world's first IgE therapeutic to enter the clinic.

Name: ImmuONE
Description:
ImmuONE specialises in human alveolar macrophage responses, epithelial cell culture platforms and testing services. Our respiratory tissue models closely resemble lung physiology to provide relevant, reliable, and reproducible results.
 
ImmuONE is partnered with the industry and academia to develop sustainable technologies for the future to support human-relevant, mechanistic driven safety assessments and develop animal product-free cell models.
 
We offer a range of standard and bespoke assessments for inhalation safety assessment needs. ImmuONE provides innovative solutions for inhalation toxicology, irritation sensitization, alveolar clearance, inflammation and can tailor to your inhalation safety assessment needs.

Together, we are pushing boundaries and reaching new heights, always driven by the shared goal of shaping a brighter and healthier future.

Life Science Group Ltd (LSG) is a specialist UK-based CDMO for media and liquid solutions. Whether it is specialist buffers for diagnostic instruments, custom media ready to go into production suites, or quality sera to enable your research or progress to the clinic, Life Science Group is well-placed to support your science.

Name: BioCote

BioCote is a market leading antimicrobial additives provider. Our open, consultative partnership approach to antimicrobial product integration is trusted by leading brands, manufacturers and product innovators worldwide.

Name: Biocentis
Description:
Biocentis is a pioneering life-science company creating a new class of products: genetically engineered insects designed to control harmful species that threaten public health, agriculture, and biodiversity.

Spun out of Imperial College London and backed by leading climate and deep-tech investors, we harness cutting-edge genome engineering and a proprietary technology platform to deliver highly effective, sustainable, and environmentally responsible insect control solutions.

With teams in the UK and Italy, we bring together a diverse and accomplished group of experts who have built companies worth billions, pioneered CRISPR technologies, and delivered some of the world's most advanced insect control solutions.

 We are growing rapidly and always keen to connect with passionate people. If you’re excited about making a global impact at the intersection of science, technology, and sustainability — let’s talk.

Name: Smart Cells
Description:
As a society we’ve always dreamt of a healthy, disease-free world.

One of the bravest moves in that direction has come from stem cell research and therapy. Stem cell therapy is currently being used to successfully treat more than 80 diseases, but we think there’s still a long way to go.

Smart Cells is the first private UK stem cell storage company to have released stored stem cell units for use in the treatment of children with life-threatening illnesses. We have released the greatest number of samples for use in successful transplants in the UK.

We believe with the development of technology in the future we will be able to treat even more illnesses, and we’re working on it.

We believe our customers deserve the best service available and we staff our state of the art facility with the top professionals in the field.

Name: NuCana plc
Description:
NuCana is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on significantly improving treatment outcomes for patients with cancer by applying our phosphoramidate chemistry technology to transform some of the most widely prescribed chemotherapy agents into more effective and safer medicines.

While these conventional agents remain part of the standard of care for the treatment of many solid tumours, their efficacy is limited by cancer cell resistance mechanisms and they are often poorly tolerated. Utilising our proprietary ProTide technology, we are developing new medicines designed to overcome key cancer resistance mechanisms and generate much higher concentrations of anti-cancer metabolites in cancer cells.

Name: RQ Biotechnology Ltd.
Description: RQ Biotechnology is making instant immunity a reality for vulnerable people. As the leading passive immunization discovery company, we partner with pharmaceutical companies to develop our antibodies into protect against infectious diseases where vaccines cannot. RQ Bio is dedicated to developing medicines based on potent broad-spectrum mAbs to provide instant and long-lasting protection for vulnerable people at risk of severe disease or death from current and future viral infections.

Name: HydRegen
Description:
HydRegen’s industrial biotechnology platforms deliver sustainable, safe and cost-efficient chemical processes. 

Partnerships with major chemicals companies have validated these technologies as ‘slot in’ replacements to precious metal catalysts, in existing chemical manufacturing infrastructure, providing a route to fast-tracking adoption of more sustainable bio-based manufacturing across the chemical sectors (current joint development projects in specialty, personal care, materials, and generics).  

By combining the benefits of milder biological conditions within intensified chemical infrastructure, we unlock at least 3xCO2e and 40% cost savings to our customers. 

We are now looking to raise £5-8m, focusing on delivering our first product (Bio2Amine) to a first 38 processes, with an end-market of £80bn and opportunity to HydRegen of £105m reoccurring revenue, before ramping our follow on products into additional markets.

For Investors: https://hydregenoxford.com/investors

Name: GenomeKey
Description:
GenomeKey enables targeted Sepsis treatment in hours, rather than days. This is important because Sepsis now kills more people than cancer. It can hit anyone, of any age, and kills within hours. A patient admitted to a hospital today, they wait 3 days before the doctor knows which antibiotic will fight the infection. 

We use cutting edge machine learning and DNA sequencing to bring 3 days down to just a few hours, with the only affordable test that provides a result for every patient. This saves lives, saves money, and saves our last antibiotics for when we really need them.

Name: ReViral
Description:
ReViral – Innovative therapies for viral diseases 

ReViral is an emerging UK-based biotechnology company aiming to help patients and to enlarge the antiviral market by developing novel first-in-class compounds.

The first target is Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) treatment which represents a major unmet medical need in children, the elderly and the immune-compromised. The very large number of patients provide a significant commercial opportunity. As its first program, ReViral is developing a novel, highly potent, small molecule inhibitor of RSV fusion RV521 which has completed its Phase 1 clinical studies and has shown significant activity in phase 2 clinical studies in adult volunteers. RV521 is now moving towards phase 2 studies in infant and adult patients.

Name: CoolLED
Description:
CoolLED designs and manufactures advanced LED illumination systems for fluorescence microscopy, transmitted light microscopy and OEM optical instrumentation.

Founded by a small team of LED illumination specialists, CoolLED introduced the first commercially available LED illumination system for fluorescence microscopy in 2006. Since then, we have helped transform light source technology for researchers, clinicians and instrument manufacturers around the world.

Our products are used across life science research, clinical imaging, neuroscience, calcium imaging, optogenetics, digital pathology, spatial biology, high-content screening and industrial applications. From everyday fluorescence microscopy to advanced multi-channel imaging, CoolLED systems deliver stable output, precise control, fast switching and long operational lifetimes.

The CoolLED product range includes broad-spectrum fluorescence light sources, multi-channel illumination systems, Fura-2 calcium imaging solutions, transmitted light systems and compact single-wavelength illuminators. We also work closely with OEMs and system builders to develop custom LED illumination platforms across UV, visible, NIR and SWIR wavelengths.

Designed and manufactured in the UK, our systems are built for performance, reliability and long-term availability, with technical support from a team that understands both the technology and the applications behind it.

Whether you are replacing mercury or metal halide lamps, improving microscope performance, integrating illumination into a new instrument or developing a bespoke optical system, CoolLED provides controllable LED illumination designed for the way modern imaging works.

Name: YEAST4BIO COST Action 18229
Description:
Economically viable conversion of low-cost renewable feedstock into biofuels and biochemicals is of utmost importance to the establishment of a robust bioeconomy. In this context, the use of microorganisms for the generation of bioproducts from renewable resources offers many advantages. More specifically, yeasts have great potential to generate industrially relevant compounds from natural sources and wastes in a cost-effective and environmentally-friendly manner.  
Non-conventional yeasts are attracting more and more attention owing to their potential to metabolize complex carbon sources, their alternative metabolic routes and their ability to cope with wide range of process conditions. In this context, this Action calls for a strong investment in capacity building through molecular biology, genetic and physiology studies of the non-conventional yeast-derived bioproducts synthesis, which at the moment is relatively scarce. Improving the knowledge on how non-conventional yeasts strains metabolize unusual substrates (carboxylic acids and biomass-derived sugars) or accumulate unusual products (food additives, enzymes, lipids), are fundamental issues to boost the transition to a more sustainable industry based on renewable raw materials.
This Action will bring together an innovative group of researchers with the combination of skills and experience to unravel how non-conventional yeast can be successfully implemented in a biotechnology industry. Besides, the Action will gather European top scientists in the field and thus become an important pillar worldwide. Participants will be given the opportunity to network and collaborate which otherwise will be limited. Furthermore, with the help of the Action, European scientists will set the future standards for research on non-conventional yeasts.

Description:
MycoNourishTM harnesses the power of beneficial microbes known as ‘arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi’ to improve crop production.

Our microbes are completely natural fungi that live underground. Working in symbiosis with plants, they act as a secondary root system, increasing plant health and improving the quantity and quality of crop yields.

These fungi are a natural part of crop production systems, forming relationships with most crops, and are present in the majority of production systems. However, the mycorrhizal fungi that are already present in these systems have unpredictable positive or negative effects on plant health.

Our product customises these interactions to suit your production systems, giving the best possible benefit to plants, and providing a reliable, sustainable means of improving yields and increasing sustainability.
